provenance.reference: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-04 CAT048 Ed 1.32 I048/250 repetitive item definition; Part 1 block and FSPEC rules
provenance.method: A minimal synthetic block contains the mandatory source identifier and a zero repetition factor for I048/250; the defined factor must be positive. Expected error kind, item and byte offset follow the authored byte positions, not diagnostic text or decoder output.
